method.description: Design reconciliation of three continuation identities against the forms they claim to continue. Each identity was tested against the packet-set component that carries it, the condition the design records for that component, and — where the parent form is retrievable — the parent's own printed instruction for the situation the condition describes. The question asked was not whether a binary could be found but whether the document the identity names is required to exist at all.
method.assignmentConstraintObserved: The stop condition requires preserving the exact not-required reason, including the custom-pleading versus no-participant-filing distinction, and forbids collapsing it into source missing or altering an adopted strategy. Each of the three identities therefore carries its own reason at its own confidence level, and the two whose parent form could not be read are recorded as undetermined rather than assimilated to the one that is established.
method.whyOneReasonWouldBeWrong: The three identities share a shape but not an evidentiary position. Giving them a single disposition would be exactly the collapse the stop condition forbids.

finding.headline: All three identities are the same normalization artefact: a role word suffixed onto a parent form number to name a continuation the Arizona Administrative Office of the Courts does not publish. For the Prop 207 petition the not-required reason is established from the issuer's own printed instruction — Arizona directs a separate petition per offence rather than a continuation page. For the set-aside and sealing petitions the artefact status is established but the substantive reason is not, because the parent forms sit behind a client-rendered index and their faces could not be read.
finding.acquisitionRequiredRationale: No issuer interaction can produce a document formed by appending -CONT to a form number. The three identities name nothing the AOC publishes. That is a different statement from 'the binary could not be obtained', and it is the statement the stop condition requires be preserved.
finding.identityShape: Each identity is its parent's exact published form code with the literal suffix -CONT appended: AOC-CREM2F-071221-CONT, AOCCR41FORM31A-082224-CONT and AOCCRSL1F-050825-CONT. The suffix is a role word, not part of any AOC form number.
finding.precedent: This repository has already resolved identifiers formed the same way. Florida's FL-RULE-3.989-CONTINUATION was a rule number with a role word suffixed onto it and named no official document; Colorado's JDF-417-ORDER was resolved the same way. The Arizona set is the same defect applied to a form number rather than a rule number, and applied three times.

resolvedIdentities.parentOfficialTitle: Petition to Expunge Records: Municipal/Justice Court
resolvedIdentities.parentIssuer: Arizona Supreme Court, Administrative Office of the Courts
resolvedIdentities.recordedConditionDescription: Where the petitioner has more counts than the form allows.
resolvedIdentities.issuerInstructionVerbatim: if you had more than one eligible offense under more than one case number, file a separate petition for each offense
resolvedIdentities.issuerInstructionLocation: item 1 of the parent petition, in the 'A. REQUIRED INFORMATION' block, printed parenthetically within the Eligible Charge instruction
resolvedIdentities.whyThisSettlesIt: The condition the design records — more counts than the form allows — is precisely the situation the parent form addresses in its own text, and the answer the issuer gives is another petition, not another page. A continuation document is not merely unpublished; it is displaced by an instruction that occupies the same ground.
resolvedIdentities.continuationConstructScan: A scan of the parent's full text for continuation, additional page, more space, attach, second sheet, separate sheet and if-needed constructs returns no continuation mechanism. The only 'ADDITIONAL' token is the section heading 'B. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION RELATED TO THE ELIGIBLE CHARGE(S)', and the only attachment language concerns supporting documentation the court may find helpful, which is evidence rather than a continuation of the petition.
resolvedIdentities.customPleadingVersusNoParticipantFiling: Neither. This is a third case and the distinction the stop condition names must not be forced onto it. The participant does file — they file another copy of the same official form. No custom pleading is drafted, and it is not a no-participant-filing situation.
resolvedIdentities.correctModelling: Model the multi-offence case as repetition of the parent official form, one instance per offence and case number, rather than as a conditional continuation component bound to a separate document.
resolvedIdentities.parentEvidenceBasis: The parent form is published on the AOC's own Prop 207 landing page as an ordinary link and was read directly. Its identity, revision, structure and digest were separately established in the preceding wave.

resolvedIdentities.parentIssuer: Arizona Supreme Court, Administrative Office of the Courts
resolvedIdentities.parentRule: Ariz. R. Crim. P. 41, Form 31(a); see also Rules 29 and 29.7
resolvedIdentities.whatIsEstablished: The AOC publishes no form bearing this code. The -CONT suffix is a role word appended to the parent's published code, and no AOC index or directory lists a continuation in this family.
resolvedIdentities.whatIsNotEstablished: What a petitioner with more than four counts is actually directed to do. The parent form is a Rule 41 rule-prescribed form published through the Self-Service Center, whose criminal forms indexes are client-rendered and expose no binary URL in server-rendered HTML. The parent's face could not be read, so its own instruction for the multi-count case — if it has one — is unknown.
resolvedIdentities.whyItIsNotAssimilatedToTheProp207Case: The Prop 207 answer rests on a specific printed sentence in a specific form. Carrying that sentence across to a different form under a different statute and a different rule would be inventing an instruction. The recorded condition is also materially different — a numeric field limit of four counts rather than a per-offence filing rule — which is the kind of difference that changes the answer.
resolvedIdentities.customPleadingVersusNoParticipantFiling: Undetermined. Not asserted in either direction.
resolvedIdentities.correctModellingForNow: Retain the component as conditional and unresolved. Do not bind it to a document, and do not close it as source-missing.
resolvedIdentities.parentRetrievableDetail: Both Self-Service Center criminal forms indexes return HTTP 200 with fully client-rendered content containing zero form links and zero AOC form codes, the site publishes no sitemap, and direct URL patterns that work for other AOC self-service forms return 404 for this code. No access restriction is involved — the obstacle is that the index is rendered in the browser.

Which form applies is itself unsettled on this track, so a continuation question sitting underneath it cannot be resolved ahead of it.

It must be modelled as repetition and must not be given its own document identity, its own edition row or its own receipt — which is precisely how a -CONT identity gets created.
The Order forms paired with the set-aside and sealing petitions. Judge-signed, and already separately bound where the design requires them. An order is not a continuation.

doNotSubstitute.why: Several Arizona counties publish their own re-branded forms, some under an express county copyright. A local sheet is not an AOC statewide form and must not be promoted to one to fill a continuation slot.

implementationFamilyEffect.effectOfThisJob: This job is recorded in the live plan as the sole remaining open dependency of rcap-az-acroform-fill over three tracks, and as one of two open dependencies of rcap-az-flat-pdf-overlay over three tracks — the other being the Arizona public-official-download job, which is completed and pushed. Establishing that none of the three continuation identities names a document removes three phantom acquisition targets from the Arizona backlog and removes the reason the acroform-fill job cannot be scheduled.
implementationFamilyEffect.familyReadinessStatement: The Arizona official-PDF family remains fail-closed and this job does not move it. Two of the six parent identities from the preceding wave remain unresolved for the same client-rendered-index reason recorded here, the licensing gate is affirmatively closed by an express reservation of rights, generation is not permitted, runtime is disabled and no field map is built. The sealing track additionally carries an undetermined eligibility_branch blocker. No packet becomes generatable and no renderer is assigned.
implementationFamilyEffect.netEffectOnBlockers: Three acquisition keys close as artefacts rather than as gaps; one closes with its substantive reason established and two with the reason recorded open.

terminalDispositionDetail.why: The narrowest disposition the evidence supports. It is not unresolved_identity in the ordinary sense: the shape of the defect is established for all three and the parents are identified. It is not acquisition_required: no issuer interaction can produce a document formed by suffixing a role word onto a form number. It is not a single not-required finding either, because only one of the three has an established reason and asserting the same reason for the other two would manufacture an instruction from a form nobody has read.

expectedDownstreamEffect: Three Arizona acquisition keys stop being open download jobs for documents the Administrative Office of the Courts has never published. The Prop 207 continuation is resolved outright, with the issuer's own printed instruction — a separate petition per offence — recorded as the reason and the correct modelling stated as repetition of the parent rather than a bound continuation document. The set-aside and sealing continuations are recorded as artefacts whose substantive reason remains open, rather than being assimilated to the Prop 207 answer or collapsed into source-missing. The sole remaining open dependency of the Arizona acroform-fill job is answered and one of two for the overlay job. No adopted strategy is altered, no component is rebound, no receipt is created, no binary enters version control, no renderer is assigned, no memo is edited, no edition is published, no packet becomes generatable, no runtime is enabled and no track changes promotion state.
